# SNIPER FEATURE SET v2 (2026-08-12) — converged from four independent evidence streams
Streams: (A) orchestrator self-audit (100 v2 calls); (B) raw-tape telltale contrast (event-grain, 273 study candidates); (C) Opus-max introspection round (40 blind calls: 7/11 takes were $1k+ winners, 13/17 losers dodged, taken/skipped 1.8x); (D) era statistics + census. Convergence count in [].

TIER 1 — build first, event grain:
1. EXPECTED-REMAINING-MOVE (capacity arithmetic): phase x runway x unspent-range/ATR x distance-to-magnets => is a B/A-class move even POSSIBLE from here. [C led with it 36/40; D: runway/trend_size top stats; A: runway gate] — the single most decisive object across streams; kills ~1/3 of candidates before any signal is read.
2. HIDDEN-SUPPLY/DEMAND RESIDUAL: signed flow vs price-change residual (flow buying + price flat = supply above; = my divergence family, C's #1 named build). [A flow-flip 80%, B flow-ACC sign-flip -0.25, C]
3. CROSS-STREAM AGREEMENT AT MAGNITUDE: stock-flow z x option-delta z joint magnitude+sign state, phase-conditioned. [A 80% x2 families, C repeated, census disagreement cells]
4. QUOTE-CHURN + BOOK-EROSION: quote revisions/sec + side-resolved book-imbalance trend from per-print attached sizes. [B top-2; my would-want closed]
5. HEDGE/BLOCK CONTAMINATION CORRECTOR: co-timed opposite-sign block/option spikes reclassified as mechanical; correct signed-flow for them. [my case009 declaration; C found it inverts headline flow twice; miner v2 pattern #3]
TIER 2:
6. VARIANCE-BUDGET STATE (B(t), budget-consumed) as the R-letter gate [C 25/40, D]
7. SWING-CHAIN SEQUENCE encoding (not pivot labels): LH/HL chain + refail counts + conf-in-30m [B sequence stats, D +, C 20/40]
8. OPTION-TAPE SILENCE: option print-rate deceleration at extremes [B -0.20]
9. VOL-SURFACE DIRECTION as gate on any flow signal (PROXY_VOL bid/ask slope + spike-and-bleed trajectory) [A 72% top-$, C named gate, my declarations]
10. 0DTE/CROWD COMPOSITION + WARE-HOUSING SPLIT (passthrough ratio) [A 80%, C hedge-durability]
DEPRIORITIZED: level distances, elephant-joins raw, absorption ratios coarse, my refusal-OVERRIDE (case003 lost: the option-refusal veto REGAINS standing — audit n was too small to kill it).
